purpose: Provide a compact spacer plate with rounded handling edges.
context: An unloaded desk prototype; no load-bearing claim is required.
manufacturing: Prototype in PLA by FDM; verify the actual printer/material settings before fabrication.

requirements.acceptance: 40 mm envelope in local X, within 0.1 mm.
requirements.verification: Measure the actual Fusion BRep envelope.

requirements.acceptance: 30 mm envelope in local Y, within 0.1 mm.
requirements.verification: Measure the actual Fusion BRep envelope.

requirements.acceptance: 4 mm envelope in local Z, within 0.1 mm.
requirements.verification: Measure the actual Fusion BRep envelope.

requirements.description: Remove sharp handling edges without changing the overall envelope.
requirements.acceptance: 1 mm native edge fillets, no failed timeline features.
requirements.verification: Inspect fillet properties and viewport; envelope checks do not prove fillet radii.

parameters.name: edge_radius
parameters.reason: A small rounding that leaves the 4 mm plate manufacturable; confirm preference.

concepts.name: extruded plate with native fillets
concepts.approach: A rectangular sketch, thickness extrusion, then edge fillets.
concepts.tradeoffs: A short editable feature history fits the simple form; radius must remain feasible relative to thickness.

selection_reason: The geometry is prismatic and simple; surface/loft modelling would add complexity without improving this brief.

features.name: footprint
features.reason: Establish the datum-aligned width and depth.

features.name: edge_rounding
features.reason: Reduce sharp handling edges while preserving the footprint.

assumptions.statement: The prototype carries no significant mechanical load.
assumptions.risk: A loaded application could require another material or thicker section.
assumptions.resolution: Confirm intended use before claiming strength or fabricating a load-bearing version.
